c.tagline: Finland's oldest city, on the Aura River and the gateway to the archipelago.

taxi.fareNote: Taxi fares are deregulated, so prices vary by company; the price list is displayed on the window and you can pre-check the estimate. Uber and Bolt both operate in Turku and are usually cheaper than a street taxi.

emergency.note: 112 is Finland's single emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance; operators speak English.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_desc: The walkable core around the Market Square and both banks of the Aura River, steps from the Cathedral, the main museums, shops and riverboat bars; the most convenient base for first-time visitors.

A charming enclave of colorful early-1900s wooden houses just southwest of the center, with the red-brick St Michael's Church nearby; a quiet, characterful residential pocket loved for its old-town atmosphere.
A leafy residential district on the river's south bank around Martin Church, lined with 1920s-30s houses, cafes and riverside walks; calm and local yet a short stroll from the center.

The dramatic hill of a former state prison, now converted into a design hotel, apartments, restaurants and saunas with panoramic city views; an atmospheric, up-and-coming spot near the river and the castle.
A green district east of the center built around Kupittaa Park (Finland's oldest public park) and the science-and-sports campus; a relaxed, family-friendly area with its own train station.

water.note: Finnish tap water is among the cleanest in the world.

transit.hours: Foli buses run from roughly 5:00am to around midnight, with some night buses on Friday and Saturday nights; the Fori river ferry runs during daytime hours.
transit.note: Turku's public transport is the Foli regional bus network, supplemented by the free Fori pedestrian ferry across the Aura River and seasonal archipelago ferries; there is no metro or tram.
transit.pay: Pay with the Foli app, a reloadable Foli travel card, or tap a contactless bank card on board; a single adult ticket is about €3.00 and gives two hours of transfers. The little Fori river ferry across the Aura is free.

ferry: Port of Turku (Viking Line & Tallink Silja terminals)

transit.m: Foli bus 1 to Market Square (~25 min)

tip.r: Service is included and tipping is not expected; rounding up the bill for exceptional service is a nice gesture.
